description: Reference text and links of the fixed page sections (everything outside the price list and estimate, which have their own tests). Taken from the live site on 14 Nov 2026. Header and About must be identical in both versions. The hero differs since the hero-integration phase (Nov 2026): Astro has the new layout and a "Call us" button; the single-file rollback copy keeps the old hero. Contact and footer differ on purpose: the Astro version shows the full confirmed business details added in Phase 2 (SEO), already reviewed and merged; the single-file site still has the shorter text. Change this file only in the same pull request that deliberately changes the page text. Since 17 Nov 2026 the header is per version too: the Astro site has no WhatsApp button in the header (one Enquire button with WhatsApp or call sits in the hero and Contact). 17 Nov 2026: the Astro header also has the dark-mode button ("Dark mode"). 17 Nov 2026: Contact now leads with the phone/WhatsApp number ("Call or WhatsApp"), then Enquire, then the other details.

about.text: About us The Cement People is a building materials supplier in Kasoa. Our range includes cement from Supacem, Dzata and Ghacem, iron rods from 8 mm to 16 mm, available by the piece or by the ton, and binding wire. Every product on this site is listed with its specification and price, giving you a clear starting point before you contact us. You can put together an estimate, send it on WhatsApp or save it as a PDF. We then confirm product availability and delivery costs for your site in Kasoa or elsewhere in Greater Accra.
